title: Get form libraries
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get form libraries that you have access to. A form library is a container for leads under a Business Center. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/pages/library/get/| /v1.3/page/library/get/| |New request parameter |/ |`page`: number
`page_size`: number | |Response parameter data type|`library_id`: number
`advertiser_id`: number
`create_time`: number
`update_time`: number |`library_id`: string
`advertiser_id`: string
`create_time`: datetime
`update_time`: datetime | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/library/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token{Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |page |number|Number of pages in response.| |page_size |number|Number of records in each page.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/library/get/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object| Returned data. | #|list|object[]|Libraries| ##| library_id | string| Form library ID | ##| library_name | string | Form library name | ##| advertiser_id | string | Advertiser ID | ##| create_time | datetime| Time when the library is created, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. An example: 2017-01-01 00:00:00.| ##| update_time | datetime| Time when the library is updated, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. An example: 2017-01-01 00:00:00. | |request_id|string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": {} } (/code) ```
